The number of traders we can actually follow each month is fixed — not because it's rare, because individual coaching has a real ceiling before the attention behind it starts to thin.

The call isn't where you get sold. It's where we confirm this applies to this trader specifically, before either side commits. Most people who apply aren't accepted — not for exclusivity, because taking someone who isn't a fit costs both sides more than saying no upfront.

Five per month.

Comment "PROFILE" and I'll open the qualification.
